product.name: LemonSlice Interactive Avatar Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creating and using interactive video avatars from images, with real-time conversations, avatar customization, voice options, and embeddable website experiences.

product.name: LemonSlice-2.1
product.description: A real-time video diffusion model that generates interactive, full-body character video from an image and audio input, with gestures, scene awareness, and text-based control.

product.name: LemonSlice API
product.description: An API for integrating LemonSlice’s interactive avatar and video-generation capabilities into websites, applications, and other services.
